prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of three differently built six-sided hexagon objects in a row on a ruled criteria sheet: an assembled interlocking unit of hexagon tiles, one sealed solid hexagon block, and a loose scatter of single hexagon tiles. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one thin rod of amber glass laid across all three objects. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
